subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the column baseplate between Foundation Plan S-101

messages.text: The column baseplate reinforcement shown in Foundation Plan S-101 conflicts with a revised bar splice noted in Sheet S-301. This is becoming a priority on our end; we'd appreciate a prompt response. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible.
Proceed with a revised bar splice per Sheet S-301; Foundation Plan S-101 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
